# Synthetic audit fixture: SSO/IAM Identity Center profile names (SPEC §27)
# in the aws-prefixed label spellings. Profile names are short arbitrary
# strings — and letter-only ones are real (`production`) — so prose safety
# lives in a length floor (one unbroken 4-plus run; the `<profile>`
# placeholder's angle bracket cannot match) plus the engine's
# GENERIC_PROFILES value gate in emit_hits, not in any value shape. The
# bare `profile` label is deliberately NOT matched: Terraform/HCL
# documentation writes `profile = "some-profile"` as an ordinary key.
# Synthetic values.
export AWS_PROFILE=corp-admin-prod
aws_profile = "corp-admin-prod"
"AwsProfile": "PowerUserAccess-123456789012"
$env:AWS_PROFILE = 'corp_admin_prod'
AWS PROFILE = CorpAdmin-Prod2
awsProfile=dev_profile
AWS_PROFILE=production
# Generic, placeholder, short and prose forms that must stay silent.
AWS_PROFILE=default
aws_profile: "example"
export AWS_PROFILE=<profile>
# The AWS profile is selected externally after SSO login.
